acceptanceCriteria: The script measures the shared layout and reproduces the V1-0212 numbers.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. Residual from V1-0198. Since V1-0212 linked worktrees share a snapshot, but script/measure-worktree-index-share.sh still assumes each worktree builds and stores its own index, so a rerun reports wrong byte counts.
title: scripts: measure-worktree-index-share.sh still assumes each linked worktree has its own index
